 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ADITYA KUMAR MOHAPATRA Order ORDER  No. 09.04.2025  01. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the Opposite Party-State.
3.

The present application has been filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by the Petitioner seeking pre- arrest bail in connection with Tangi P.S. Case No.36 of 2016, corresponding to G.R. Case No.58 of 2016, pending in the court of learned NGN-cum-J.M.F.C., Tangi, for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 341/294/323/307/376/506/34 of the amit IPC.
4.
It is stated by learned counsel for the Petitioner that earlier the petitioner had approached this Court by filing ABLAPL No.2680 of 2020.

He further contended that vide order dated 23.02.2022,
the petitioner was directed to surrender and go on bail.
He further contended that at the time of surrender, the petitioner was having one criminal antecedent as a result of which he could not get the advantage of the said order.

5. Considering the nature of allegation, gravity of offence and the facts and circumstances of the Ajay Balabantray @ Aju vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28555690/
1 case, I am not inclined to grant pre-arrest bail to the Petitioner.

opennyai_summary.decision:
However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders before the Court in seisin over the matter within a period of four weeks from today and moves an application for bail, the Court in seisin over the matter shall release him on bail in connection with the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, subject to verification of criminal antecedent.
In the event it is found by the court in seisin over the matter that the Petitioner is having more than one criminal antecedent, then this order shall not be given effect to.
6. The release of the Petitioner shall also be subject to following conditions:-
i) shall cooperate with the investigation and appear before the I.O. as and when his presence is required and shall cooperate with the early conclusion of the investigation;
ii) shall appear before the Trial Court on each and every date fixed without fail, if not prevented by sufficient cause;
iii) shall not indulge in any similar offence;
iv) Further, the release of the Petitioner shall also be subject to furnishing a cash security of Rs.2,000/- (Rupees two thousand) each before the Court in seisin over the matter which shall be kept in interest bearing fixed deposit account in the name of the court in any nationalized bank and renewed from time to time till disposal of the case.
The said deposit shall be subject to the final outcome of the trial.
Violation of any of the terms and conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
7. Accordingly, the ABLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
